<insights>
- The Galaxy J7 Perx has a screen size of 5.5" with a resolution of 720 x 1280.
- We need to find the RAM specifications for devices with the same screen size and resolution as the Galaxy J7 Perx.
</insights>

<answer>
The RAMs of the Samsung Galaxy J7's in the Samsung Galaxy J Series with the same screen as the Galaxy J7 Perx are as follows:
- Galaxy J7 (2015): 1.5 GB
- Galaxy J7 (2016): 2 GB
- Galaxy J7 Prime: 3 GB
- Galaxy J7 (2017) / J7 Pro (2017): 3 GB
- Galaxy J7+ (2017): 4 GB
- Galaxy J7 Max (2017): 4 GB
- Galaxy J7 Nxt / J7 Core / J7 Neo (2017): 2 GB/3 GB
- Galaxy J7 Perx: 2 GB
- Galaxy J7 V (2017): 2 GB
- Galaxy J7 Sky Pro (2017): 2 GB
- Galaxy J7 (2018): 2 GB
- Galaxy J7 Duo (2018): 4 GB
- Galaxy J7 Prime 2 (2018): 3 GB
</answer>
